title: Travel & instances
summary: City routes, rings, spires, waypoints and private dungeon runs.
body:
Ten city routes with return books

Speak to Merrin in the tunnel for ten city destinations. Return books bring you back to the shared hub.

Druid Ring travel

Khalure offers the currently available Classic Druid Rings. Some routes and client installations still need checks. Report silent travel or missing-world failures to the owner.

Wizard Spire travel

Khaleid offers eight Classic Wizard Spire destinations from the tunnel travel area.

A Plane of Knowledge connection

A dedicated travel connection keeps the Plane of Knowledge reachable alongside the tunnel’s city routes.

Nightcap Recall

Make a hotkey for Ancient Attunement in the General abilities tab. It returns you to the tunnel with a five-second cast and ten-minute reuse, preserving your bind point and other home destinations.

Travel to places you have discovered

Find waypoint markers to unlock return destinations with the Waypoint Master. Discovering them all is a custom exploration quest.

Private dungeon runs

Instance Keepers offer Befallen, Unrest, High Keep, Najena, Cazic-Thule, Permafrost, and Nagafen’s Lair. Hail to enter or join your group leader; use #instances for open runs and timers. Runs last 12 hours. Resets ask for confirmation and discard that instance’s kills and progress. The small floating-eye Keeper is separate from the waypoint portal.

Not released: Raid and Grind dungeon modes are a test candidate. Existing private instances keep their current behavior until a separate release.
sources: docs/dungeons/{SPEC,README,QA}.md and catalog.json; dungeon candidate, not deployed
